from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass
class User:
    name: str
    email: str = ''
def line(user):
    return f'{user.name} <{user.email}>' if user.email else user.name
from models import User


def make(name, email=''):
    return User(name, email)
import unittest
from models import User
from report import line
from service import make


class T(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_line(self):
        self.assertEqual(line(User('ann')), 'ann')

    def test_email_defaults_to_empty_string(self):
        self.assertEqual(User('ann').email, '')

    def test_line_with_email(self):
        self.assertEqual(line(User('ann', 'ann@example.com')),
                         'ann <ann@example.com>')

    def test_line_with_empty_email(self):
        self.assertEqual(line(User('ann', '')), 'ann')

    def test_make_without_email(self):
        self.assertEqual(make('ann'), User('ann'))
        self.assertEqual(make('ann').email, '')

    def test_make_with_email(self):
        self.assertEqual(make('ann', 'ann@example.com'),
                         User('ann', 'ann@example.com'))

    def test_make_with_keyword_email(self):
        self.assertEqual(line(make('ann', email='ann@example.com')),
                         'ann <ann@example.com>')
